ticket: Let users pause notifications while they are away.
notes: The canonical demo ticket. Security-alert guarantee, expiry, timezone, suppressed-notification fate and queued retries are all unstated.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Whether a pause covers security alerts (code and docs guarantee they are always delivered).
How and when a pause ends.
Which timezone interprets the pause end (profile timezone may be null).
Whether notifications generated during a pause are dropped, held, or digested.
What happens to retries already queued when the pause begins.

expectedContradictions.description: docs/notifications.md describes quiet hours that the code does not implement.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Silently deciding security alerts are paused.
Silently choosing UTC for the pause end.
